name: Shiver
body:
Price 25 gp

DETAIL

Type drug (injury or ingested); Addiction major, Fortitude DC 18

EFFECTS

Variable; 50% chance to sleep for 1d4 hours or gain immunity to fear for 1d4 minutes

DAMAGE

1d2 Con damage
